commits.subject: fix(web): use correct agent URL when multiple agents are configured
commits.body:
Previously, getAgentUrl() always returned the first agent's URL regardless
of which machine was selected. Now it correctly looks up the connection
by machineId. Also removes redundant cloud config icon from header.

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(cloud-agent): enable Git commits via GitHub OAuth token
commits.body:
Fly.io cloud agents can now commit to Git repositories by leveraging
the existing GitHub OAuth token. The token is set as a Fly.io secret
on agent creation and configured via gh CLI on container startup.

- Add setSecrets() GraphQL function to flyio-client
- Fetch GitHub token and set as Fly.io secrets during agent creation
- Add entrypoint.sh to configure gh auth and Git identity on startup
- Update Dockerfile to use entrypoint script

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
